resolutions.researcher_notes: PNGRB's 2010 authorisation order is a primary regulatory finding of fact (based on GAIL's submitted commissioning proof) stating the network 'has already been completed and commissioned between year 1991 to 2005' -- directly supports StartYear1=1991 as the start of that commissioning range; the per-segment annexure in the same document corroborates 1991 for specific sections.
